title: Excession
author: Iain M. Banks
summary: In Iain M. Banks's Culture series, an artefact that seems more advanced than anything known appears in deep space. Culture Minds and rival civilisations scheme over how to deal with it.
readIf: you like intricate space opera with witty AI ships and big ideas.
skipIf: you are new to the Culture or want a straightforward plot.
